iOS 27 beta 5 was released yesterday, and in addition to the redesigned app icons and new Siri AI voice options, this update can also make Liquid Glass more transparent than ever.

The iOS 27 Liquid Glass slider can also be adjusted to be more transparent in beta 5

iOS 27 will be officially released next month, bringing optimizations to Apple's Liquid Glass design across multiple aspects of the iPhone interface.

However, iOS 27 also adds an important customization tool: the Liquid Glass slider.

The new slider is located in "Settings" → "Appearance" → "Liquid Glass," allowing you to freely adjust the transparency of Liquid Glass. You can make it very transparent, very colorful, or anywhere in between.

And in this week's beta 5, Apple has adjusted this slider so that the most transparent setting is even more transparent than before.

You can see a great comparison on X from Beta Profiles:

This change is not a huge one, but if you like to make UI elements as transparent as possible, iOS 27 can provide a more "glass-like" experience.

The benefit of the slider is that no matter what your preference is, iOS 27 can help you achieve it.

How do you want to set the look of your Liquid Glass? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
